notes: DEMO DATA. Recordings are from the public MIMII DG dataset (Dohi et al., 2022; Zenodo 6529888; CC-BY-4.0), test split, which the model was not trained on. Clips were chosen at random (seed 0). File names show the true label (normal_ / anomaly_). Test recordings were uploaded normal first, then anomalous, to simulate a fault starting part-way.
